shots.prompt: Inside a glowing crystal cave, water drips, light shimmers
lines: They hid in the crystal caves. But shadows can follow anywhere.

shots.prompt: The group catches their breath, the cat shakes off dust
Crystals vibrate and ring, dust falling from the ceiling
She sits on a rock, troubled
lines: Compass, tell me the truth. What is she?

shots.prompt: Compass projects a hologram of two identical women in capsules
lines: She was the first. Version one. She was never finished.

shots.prompt: Ashley slides under a falling crystal, Ava pulls her up
She frowns
She shakes her head
Crystal creatures form a glowing bridge over a chasm
The crystals suddenly dim and turn red one by one
The pale twin walks through the cave, red light following her
lines: Give me your name, Twenty-Three. You don't deserve it.

shots.prompt: The cat sprints through the tunnel ahead of everyone
He shouts bravely
Ryan sings and the crystal creatures leap into a glowing shield wall
Ashley and Ava leap across a gap between floating rocks
The group sprints through a tunnel as crystals crash behind them
A cave wall collapses in a burst of blue light and dust
Red searchlights sweep across the stormy sky
She pulls Ashley up
They burst out of the cave into daylight and leap across a gap
lines: They escaped. But the Shadow had left a clue behind.

shots.prompt: Ashley pulls her friends up onto a cliff edge
Compass glows and decodes a signal, the map zooms to a dark fortress
lines: Kai's signal. It comes from the Fortress.

shots.prompt: She looks toward the horizon
lines: Kai. His name is Kai. I remember now.

shots.prompt: A lantern swings through the fog, getting closer
The dark fortress on its island, storm clouds and red lights
She grimaces
lines: Nobody walks into the Fortress and walks out.

shots.prompt: The cat salutes with its paw, very serious
He grins
Ashley stands on the cliff, wind blowing, looking at the fortress
A lantern light moves through the mist toward them
An old man with a glowing green pendant raises a lantern
lines: If you want to reach the Fortress, you'll need me.

shots.prompt: Sunset across the islands, the group follows the old man
lines: The old man had a name. And a secret.
